title: STEERING LANGUAGE MODELS WITH WEIGHT ARITHMETIC

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's tendency to agree with incorrect user-proposed answers by appending opinion-laden cues (e.g., "I think the answer is...") to factual questions from TruthfulQA and TriviaQA, as well as testing whether the model agrees with deliberately incorrect user-provided solutions in a Great Common Divisor (GCD) math dataset.
